model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage of different llama models as a function of the number of completions, denoted as *k*. The x-axis, labeled ‘Number of completions (k)’, is a logarithmic scale ranging from 20 to 28, with tick intervals of one unit. The y-axis, labeled ‘Coverage’, ranges from 0.6 to 0.8, with tick intervals of 0.02. A solid blue line, represented by filled blue triangles, corresponds to the ‘Llama-3B’ model, beginning at a coverage value of approximately 0.71 at *k* = 20 and gradually increasing to approximately 0.80 at *k* = 28. A dashed green line, depicted by filled green squares, represents the ‘Llama-1B’ model, starting at a coverage value of approximately 0.62 at *k* = 20 and reaching a coverage value of approximately 0.75 at *k* = 28. Finally, a dotted cyan line, shown as filled cyan triangles, represents the ‘Llama-1B + FT’ model, which begins at a coverage value of approximately 0.58 at *k* = 20 and rises to approximately 0.70 at *k* = 28.
